# Country flag assets

These 3:2 SVGs are sourced from [catamphetamine/country-flag-icons](https://github.com/catamphetamine/country-flag-icons) version 1.6.20 at commit 2e6b8090a4c59101f42d34e966a099d07c33b4bc.

The registry contains the 249 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 countries and territories, plus XK for Kosovo. Subdivision, regional, and private-use flags are intentionally excluded. See LICENSE for the upstream MIT license.
